shared_or_similar_visual_information: Two raised interval traces with circular boundary marks on a number line. Compare the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 3 in the left image with the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 3 in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The traces cover opposite sides and neither covers the middle value 2. Right image: One marked ray lies below 1 and the other above 3, leaving the middle gap outside both.
Rationales: The selected cue in each image leaves the middle interval uncovered by both traces. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
